review.reason: The mapped course layout, hazards, greens, and striped fairways are represented clearly. However, added trees appear in Hole 2’s tee-to-first-landing corridor and visually obstruct the mapped shot line.

issues.detail: A tree crown just beyond T2 overlaps the broad corridor from the tee toward the first fairway landing area.
issues.consequence: The overview suggests that the tee shot is obstructed by trees, obscuring the intended open carry.
